svg.aria-label: Map of the United States: Alaska and Hawaii are separate insets, not at actual relative positions or the same scale
svg.metadata: U.S. county boundary geometry from Basemap 2.0.0 UScounties dataset, derived from NOAA Coastal Geospatial Data Project; county geometries dissolved to national land for the 50 states and District of Columbia; NAD83/EPSG:4269 transformed to WGS84/EPSG:4326; Alaska antimeridian geometry normalized westward for inset rendering; Lower 48, Alaska, and principal Hawaiian Islands rendered as geographically accurate local insets; illustrated treatment: JOURNEY ATLAS.

g.text: ※ アラスカ・ハワイは位置・縮尺を変えた別枠表示です。
